descriptionPlain:
The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we’re behind some of Spotify’s most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you’ll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them.
We are the Voice Production Team, the creative team behind Spotify’s AI voice experiences. We think about AI voices from a casting perspective — including voice type, age and gender — and from a performance perspective, recognizing that a voice may need to perform differently for DJ than it does for an audiobook recap. We bring expertise in voice casting, direction, recording and production, and work closely with Speak to set the quality bar for AI voice models across experiences including AI DJ, Generative AI Ads, Personalized Podcasts, Agent Voice Chat and more.
As a Senior Product Quality Analyst, you’ll bring a dedicated evaluation perspective to the team. You’ll own how we define and measure AI voice quality, bringing together Voice Production’s creative bar, Speak’s technical bar and the wider industry bar. Your goal won’t simply be to determine whether Spotify has the “best” AI voice technology on the market. You’ll help us answer a more important question: is our technology the best at serving Spotify’s specific needs?

descriptionPlain:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.
The Stream Reporting team is responsible for capturing and processing the consumption signals that power some of Spotify’s most important experiences and business functions. Our systems help ensure accurate royalty reporting, support experimentation and analytics, and provide trusted data that informs recommendations and personalization across Spotify.
We’re looking for an Android Engineer to join a highly collaborative team working at the intersection of mobile development, data, and platform systems. This is an opportunity to build software that operates at Spotify scale and helps power experiences used by millions of listeners every day. You’ll help shape how listening and engagement signals are captured across Spotify’s mobile experiences and transformed into trusted datasets used throughout the company.

descriptionPlain:
Spotify is looking for a short-term contractor for the Artist & Label Partnerships team in Vietnam. 
The Artist & Label Partnerships team are the face of Spotify to artists, managers, labels & distributors. Focusing on the Vietnamese music landscape, this role will serve as the point of contact for record labels, distributors and artists, ensuring that artists & their teams are familiar with Spotify standard methodologies, resources and tools. The role will closely support the cross-functional teams with on-platform promotion and off-platform artist marketing. 

Please note this is a fixed-term, 6 months, contractor role hired through a third party.

descriptionPlain:
We are looking for a strategic-minded, execution-oriented Artists & Label Partnerships Manager for Taiwan, to join Spotify’s Music team based in Taipei. In this role, you will be part of the Music team in Southeast Asia, reporting to the regional Head of Artists & Label Partnerships.
 
You will sit at the heart of the music ecosystem, moving between high-level release strategies and the day-to-day tactical execution that drives artist and business growth. This role is perfect for a music industry professional who thrives on building relationships and navigating the intersection of technology and creativity.
 
Our ideal candidate has fun at work and a desire to make a positive impact on the music industry as a whole. Above all, your work will impact the way the world experiences music and strengthen Spotify’s role as a trusted, culturally relevant voice in the music landscape. This role is based in Taipei and will require international travel occasionally.
